mechanics.claim: Applies spell damage on the initial vault; the empowered attack's 3 hits deal basic (on-hit-eligible) damage instead.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the initial vault. Deals {{tip|basic damage}} on all the attacks from the empowered ability.

mechanics.claim: Each of the 3 empowered strikes is affected by critical strike modifiers and applies on-hit effects.
mechanics.quote: Each hit is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack rolls a single critical strike check that applies to all 3 strikes together.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack rolls a {{tip|critical strike}} once for all strikes; either all will critically strike, or none will.

mechanics.claim: The empowered Shield Vault attack resets Pantheon's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Empowered Shield Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Pantheon's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not count as three separate basic attacks for on-attack/windup-interacting effects (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades), which only trigger once.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack does not cause '''Pantheon''' to attack thrice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Shield Vault''.

mechanics.claim: The 3 empowered strikes each count as a separate cast instance for effects like Electrocute and Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: The 3 strikes that occur after ''Empowered Shield Vault'' each count as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}}

mechanics.claim: Pantheon is unable to act until the last of the 3 empowered strikes lands, and total attack time scales with his attack speed.
mechanics.quote: Despite the multi-hit attack only having a hidden cast time, '''Pantheon''' will remain {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} until the last strike has been dealt.

mechanics.claim: The vault deals a stun for 1 second on landing (crowd control, does not affect damage in either fight type).
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second
